about: Music slots asked through music_queue.py. The prompt of each ask is music_style.prompt(slot, n): the slot's text, the house style and, from the second take on, the variation line. Our own content only: never a game, composer or work (prompt_guard.py). First used by the main session on 2026-11-17 (14 tracks, build/music-gemini/).
house: Instrumental only: no vocals, no lyrics, no spoken words (a wordless choir pad is fine where asked). Original composition for a dark medieval fantasy role-playing game set on cursed islands. Acoustic, organic instruments with a dusty, reverb-drenched, slightly lo-fi production; no electronic beats, no synth leads, no modern pop or cinematic trailer sound. Loopable background music: steady texture from start to end, no long fade-in or fade-out, no big ending. Around three minutes.
variation: A different take from any earlier one: new melody and arrangement.

slots.text: Main menu theme. Brooding and lonely, about 65 bpm, minor key. A solo fingerpicked nylon-string acoustic guitar carries a slow, sparse melody over a low cello drone; soft distant wordless choir swells now and then; a feeling of an old, cursed world waiting.

Harbour town theme. Melancholic and calm but haunted, about 70 bpm, minor key. Fingerpicked acoustic guitar (slightly detuned, twelve-string colour) with gentle open chords, a quiet sea-wind ambience bed, an occasional low wooden flute phrase, lots of room reverb.

Dark forest wilderness. Quiet but unsettling, about 60 bpm. Ambient low string drones, wind through old trees, sparse plucked dulcimer notes, a distant wordless choir that comes and goes, creaking wood textures; mostly atmosphere with very little melody.

Volcanic ash island. Ominous and oppressive, about 55 bpm. Deep rumbling drones, slow heavy hand drums far away, low brass swells, metallic scrapes and hisses, a dry heat-haze feeling; sparse and heavy.

Underground mines and caverns. Tense and very sparse. Cavernous reverb, water drips, deep sub drones, faint metallic chimes, slow dissonant string clusters swelling and fading, the sense of something waiting in the dark.

Dungeon fight. Tense and driving, about 110 bpm, minor key. Low taiko and frame drums, a staccato low-strings ostinato, dark choir hits on the accents, a grim medieval colour; keep the energy steady so it loops.

Boss fight against an ancient guardian of a volcanic forge. Grim and epic, about 100 bpm. Heavy pounding percussion with anvil-like metal hits, grinding low brass, a dark choir, relentless and loopable.

versions_about: More tracks for a slot's pool, in that slot's style (the owner, 2026-11-25: a wider soundtrack of the same styles). Each is the text of its slot (`of`) with another lead instrument, mood or tempo, asked once: `music_queue.py run --slots <id>,... --takes 1` writes `<id>_1.mp4`, and `music_import.py` ships it as the extra version `<id minus its slot>_1` of that slot's pool (picks.json `<slot>_pool`). The six cave versions of 2026-11-18 (mine, crystal, flooded, abyss, ossuary, ember) were asked by hand: their prompts are in assets/prompts/sounds/music/gemini/. Delivered on 2026-11-25: title_vigil (its second ask), title_embers, town_puerto_dusk, bosque_mist, volcan_cinder, cave_echo, boss_forge_bellows. Still to ask (Gemini answered three asks in a row with text and no track, so the run was stopped): town_puerto_tide, bosque_hollow, volcan_ridge, cave_roots, boss_forge_slag.

versions.text: Main menu theme. Brooding and lonely, about 60 bpm, minor key. A solo cello carries a slow, mournful melody over sparse fingerpicked nylon-string acoustic guitar arpeggios and a low drone; soft distant wordless choir swells now and then; a feeling of an old, cursed world keeping watch through the night.

Main menu theme. Brooding and weary with a faint thread of hope, about 70 bpm, minor key. A fingerpicked nylon-string acoustic guitar trades a slow, sparse melody with a low wooden flute over a low cello drone; a few soft hammered dulcimer notes answer now and then; distant wordless choir; a feeling of an old, cursed world waiting.

Harbour town theme at dusk. Melancholic and calm but haunted, about 66 bpm, minor key. Fingerpicked acoustic guitar (slightly detuned, twelve-string colour) with gentle open chords, a slow solo fiddle melody far back in the room, a quiet sea-wind ambience bed, lots of room reverb.

Harbour town theme on a grey morning. Melancholic and calm but haunted, about 74 bpm, minor key, a gentle lilting three-four sway. Fingerpicked acoustic guitar (slightly detuned, twelve-string colour), long soft concertina notes underneath, an occasional low wooden flute phrase, a quiet sea-wind ambience bed, lots of room reverb.

Dark forest wilderness in the mist. Quiet but unsettling, about 56 bpm. Ambient low string drones, wind through old trees, a lone low wooden flute with long breathy notes, a distant wordless choir that comes and goes, creaking wood textures; mostly atmosphere with very little melody.

Dark forest wilderness, deep among the oldest trees. Quiet but unsettling, about 64 bpm. Ambient low string drones, wind through old trees, sparse plucked harp notes, a soft frame drum like a slow heartbeat far away, a distant wordless choir that comes and goes, creaking wood textures; mostly atmosphere with very little melody.

Volcanic ash island. Ominous and oppressive, about 52 bpm. Deep rumbling drones, slow heavy hand drums far away, a low bowed double bass line that rises and sinks, metallic scrapes and hisses, a dry heat-haze feeling; sparse and heavy.

Volcanic ash island, high on the burnt ridge. Ominous and oppressive, about 58 bpm. Deep rumbling drones, slow heavy hand drums far away, low brass swells, a lone low horn repeating a slow three-note call, distant ringing metal, a dry heat-haze feeling; sparse and heavy.

A vast echoing cavern deep underground. Tense and very sparse. Cavernous reverb, water drips, deep sub drones, a few soft bowed-metal tones that ring for a long time, slow dissonant string clusters swelling and fading, the sense of something waiting in the dark.

Narrow earthen tunnels under old roots. Tense and very sparse, about 58 bpm. Close, damp reverb, water drips, deep sub drones, dry wooden knocks, a slow low flute phrase that comes and goes, faint string harmonics, the sense of something waiting in the dark.

Boss fight against an ancient guardian of a volcanic forge. Grim and epic, about 96 bpm. Heavy pounding percussion with anvil-like metal hits, a driving low-strings ostinato in front, grinding low brass, a dark choir, relentless and loopable.

Boss fight against an ancient guardian of a volcanic forge. Grim and epic, about 104 bpm, a heavy six-eight pulse. Pounding war drums with anvil-like metal hits on the accents, grinding low brass stabs, a dark wordless male choir carrying the theme, relentless and loopable.
